How to identify and use this concept

  1. Locate the original lesson or transcript that defines the term.
  2. Write down the exact candle, range and confirmation rule used by that source.
  3. Mark the zone on replay and record price interaction without hindsight edits.
  4. Compare results with a predeclared baseline before considering practical use.
Use as a research glossary entry until a reliable primary definition can be verified.

Common mistakes and limitations

Treating a niche label as universally defined; using it as a trade trigger without a reproducible rule.
